notice.default: Scores are not yet validated by a backtest and paper trading. These are neutral candidates for you to research, not instructions to trade. Not financial advice.

ChallengeRequiredOut.description: 403 body of `POST /auth/login` when a Cloudflare Turnstile token is needed.

ChartAnnotation.title: ChartAnnotation
ChartAnnotation.description: Something the chart should draw: a level, a moving average or a detected pattern.

ExitReviewIn.title: ExitReviewIn
ExitReviewIn.description: A what-if: `horizon` / `risk` override every holding's own for this review only.

Explanation.title: Explanation
Explanation.description:
The "Why?" of a scored object (CLAUDE.md shape), versioned and stored with it.

`summary`, `inputs` and `rules_applied` are the v0 fields the frontend already reads; they stay
as part of v1. Every field after them has a default, so payloads cached before v1 still load.

ExplanationSource.title: ExplanationSource
ExplanationSource.description: Where a number came from and how fresh it is.

value_note.title: Value Note
value_note.default: The dataset has monthly returns only. Enter the value from your fund statement as the holding's manual value.

FundHoldingOut.title: FundHoldingOut
FundHoldingOut.description:
What the app knows about a fund holding (symbol `GEMEL-<fund id>`). The value is the user's
own entry (`manual_value`): GemelNet has monthly returns, not a unit price.

FundMonth.title: FundMonth
FundMonth.description: One reporting month. A value the dataset left empty stays None (never a neutral 0).

IdeaAlertsFilter.title: IdeaAlertsFilter
IdeaAlertsFilter.description: The filter a candidate must match before a push. Every field is required: no defaults.

ImportRowsBody.title: ImportRowsBody
ImportRowsBody.description: On-device OCR: the browser parsed the screenshot, only the stock rows are sent.

MatchCandidate.title: MatchCandidate
MatchCandidate.description: A possible security for a row whose name match was too weak to accept automatically.

MissingInput.title: MissingInput
MissingInput.description: A signal or data field the Scout has nothing for: reported, never counted as neutral.

QuietHours.title: QuietHours
QuietHours.description: No pushes between `start` and `end` (Asia/Jerusalem). The window may wrap midnight.

max_portfolio_risk_per_trade_pct.title: Max Portfolio Risk Per Trade Pct

RowConflict.title: RowConflict
RowConflict.description:
The numbers of the copy that lost when the same card is in two screenshots with different
values (the later screenshot wins). Reported so the user can see what was dropped.

ScaleOutPlan.title: ScaleOutPlan
ScaleOutPlan.description: The profile's scale-out numbers and the wording that labels them an adjustable plan.

SignalContribution.title: SignalContribution
SignalContribution.description: One signal's part in a combined score: what it said and how much it counted.

SizeGuidance.title: SizeGuidance
SizeGuidance.description: The stop stays where the chart puts it; this is how many shares fit the risk filter.

StopState.title: StopState
StopState.description: What a trailing stop remembers between runs: the highest high seen and the stop so far.

TextCode.title: TextCode
TextCode.description:
A stable machine code plus its numbers, so the UI can write the sentence in its own language.

It sits beside the English text and never replaces it; `params` holds only numbers and short codes.
